verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no Linear capability for building custom views or dashboard widgets that render natively inside the product, such as a UI extension SDK or widget framework. Sharing filtered-view URLs (linear-docs-13) is an adjacent feature. The 'custom dashboards and analytics' entry (linear-docs-84) is a third-party listing in the integrations directory, not a native extension point. The GraphQL API and SDK are developer building blocks for external tools, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build custom views and dashboard widgets that feel native to the product
